frontmatter.title: Personal Portfolio (V2)
frontmatter.subheading: A Next.js/MDX portfolio with its own content-clone pipeline
frontmatter.excerpt: A Next.js static portfolio that clones a private MDX content repo at build time, renders typed collections through a ContentRepository, and deploys to AWS S3 + CloudFront across develop, stage, and production.
frontmatter.problem: A hand-rolled static site could not keep up with real content authoring, typed collections, or multi-environment deploys.
frontmatter.approach: Next.js 13 SSG with MDX, atomic SCSS modules, a build-time content-repo clone, and a branch-gated S3/CloudFront CI/CD pipeline.
frontmatter.outcome: Ran as the live personal site for years and established the content-at-build pattern that v3 later evolved into a SQLite pipeline.
